description: This is a Java class 'LogViewer' that serves as a GUI component for browsing and selecting log files within the rusEfi project. It provides functionality to open folders, list log files matching a specific filter, and load selected log files for further processing and display.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that provides a user interface for browsing, selecting, and loading log files related to rusEfi engine diagnostics and visualization.

methods.name: LogViewer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log viewer panel with UI components for folder selection, file listing, and displays.

methods.name: refreshCountPanel
methods.description: Updates the panel displaying the count of total digital charts from ChartRepository.

methods.name: openFolder
methods.description: Loads log files from the specified folder, filters them, and automatically opens the latest non-current log file if available.

methods.name: getFileDesc
methods.description: Creates a FileItem description object for a given file.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Loads and parses the selected log file, initializing engine state and updating the chart repository with data from the log.
